current_stances.position: Ubique maintains that affective and defensive expressions in non-human primates—such as motionless staring, eyebrow movement, and graded fear responses to novel stimuli like turtles versus snakes—represent evolutionarily continuous adaptive behaviors shaped by natural selection.
